statement.en: Each formation taking, at each sense, a form more than half the formations hold, where there is one, makes no form; two of three agree at once and one of two rests, so agreement under it still needs a break of symmetry.
statement.zh: 各形成在每一义取多于半数所持之形，无则守己：从众不造形；三中二同即一致，二中一同则不动，所以从众之下一致仍需打破对称。

laws.en: Counting the holders of a form at a sense, taking what most hold keeps a formation's form where no form has more than half, and every form after it was held before by some formation.
laws.zh: 计一义上持一形者之数，从众在无形过半时守己之形，其后每一形皆先为某形成所持。

laws.en: Three formations, two holding one form: all hold it after one step. Two formations holding different forms: taking what most hold changes nothing.
laws.zh: 三形成中二持一形：一步之后皆持之。二形成各持一形：从众不改任何。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; a finite list of formations; decidable equality of forms.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；有限之形成列表；形之相等可判定。

does_not_show.en: That majority rule agrees from every start, or that any group follows it.
does_not_show.zh: 从众自每一起点一致，或某群从之。

correspondence.en: Majority dynamics on a complete graph: odd splits settle at once, even splits tie.
correspondence.zh: 完全图上之多数动力：奇数之分即定，偶数之分相持。

detail.en: A rule reading more than two codes, which that record lists as not derived.
detail.zh: 读多于两码之规则，该记录列为未推出。
